provenance.source: WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide patterns as cited in references/frameworks/aria-apg.md
provenance.basis: Failure classes and the adequacy rule in SKILL.md, preserving the prior decision that modal dialog, combobox, and menu button patterns remain manual-only until their mode, popup, and focus semantics can be asserted faithfully

criteria.title: Widget exposes the pattern's expected role, name, and state
criteria.notes: An accessibility-tree assertion decides role and name. Patterns whose state depends on assistive-technology mode remain manual-only and are not promoted by this entry.

criteria.title: Widget implements the pattern's expected keyboard interaction
criteria.notes: Driving the documented keys across focus and open states decides this. A static scan cannot see key handling.

criteria.title: Pattern notifications reach assistive technology
criteria.notes: Decidable only in a state that produces a notification.
